newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Three arrested over Amsterdam airfreight thefts.
newsitem.headline: Three arrested over Amsterdam airfreight thefts.

text.p: Dutch detectives have arrested three people as part of an investigation into alleged theft of airfreight at Schiphol airport, the Amsterdam police authority said in a statement.

It added they were arrested following a joint investigation with the Dutch military police which is responsible for security at Amsterdam's airport. The three are alleged to have stolen goods from companies involved in ground handling and warehousing at Schiphol, it said.
Two of the three are employed by an unidentified company at the airport, the police said.

The police investigation discovered a number of items, including computers, computer components, cordless telephones and video cameras. In total the police seized goods weighing more than a tonne, the statement said.
The three arrested persons will appear before a Dutch judge to face charges of theft, it added.

Separately the Dutch military police are investigating a further five people directly employed at the airport who will face similar theft charges, while another person employed by an unnamed airline at Schiphol has been charged in connection with the posession of an allegedly stolen computer, the police statement said.
